name: autofix.ci

on:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  checks: write
  contents: write

jobs:
  autofix:
    name: Lints, handles new assets, and commits changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        env:
          cache-name: cache-dependencies
        with:
          # npm cache files are stored in `~/.npm` on Linux/macOS
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-
            ${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Convert new assets to svg
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: pnpm convert-new-assets-to-svg

      - name: Clean assets
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: pnpm clean-assets

      - name: Sort
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: pnpm sort

      - name: Prettier
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: pnpm format

      - name: Type check
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: pnpm type-check

      - name: Commit clean assets
        uses: autofix-ci/action@ff86a557419858bb967097bfc916833f5647fa8c

name: json-to-ts

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  generate-types:
    name: Generate TypeScript types from JSON
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main

      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        env:
          cache-name: cache-dependencies
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-
            ${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Generate TypeScript types
        run: pnpm json-to-ts

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          title: "chore: update generated types"
          body: "Automatically generated TypeScript types from JSON files"
          branch: "update/generated-types"
          base: main
          commit-message: "chore: update generated types"
          delete-branch: true

name: Validate vaults, tokens, and validators

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - src/vaults/**/*.json
      - src/tokens/**/*.json
      - src/validator/**/*.json
      - src/schema/*.json
      - scripts/**/*.*
      - package.json

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.head_ref }}
          repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}

      - name: Cache dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        env:
          cache-name: cache-dependencies
        with:
          # npm cache files are stored in `~/.npm` on Linux/macOS
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.cache-name }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-build-
            ${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Validate JSON schema and rules
        run: pnpm validate

{
  "name": "@infrared-dao/default-list",
  "version": "1.0.1",
  "description": "Default lists for Infrared interfaces including vaults, tokens, and validators",
  "keywords": [
    "berachain",
    "default",
    "token",
    "vaults",
    "vault",
    "validator",
    "list"
  ],
  "homepage": "https://github.com/infrared-dao/infrared-default-list#readme",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/infrared-dao/infrared-default-list.git"
  },
  "license": "GPL-3.0-or-later",
  "sideEffects": false,
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    "./protocols": "./dist/protocols.ts",
    "./tokens/mainnet": "./dist/tokens/mainnet.ts",
    "./types/protocols": "./src/types/protocols.d.ts",
    "./types/tokens": "./src/types/tokens.d.ts",
    "./types/vaults": "./src/types/vaults.d.ts",
    "./types/validators": "./src/types/validators.d.ts",
    "./vaults/mainnet": "./dist/vaults/mainnet.ts",
    "./vaults/validators": "./dist/vaults/validators.ts"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "check": "concurrently \"pnpm schemas-to-typescript\" \"pnpm sort\" \"pnpm validate\" && pnpm lint",
    "clean-assets": "concurrently \"pnpm clean-assets:svg\" \"pnpm clean-assets:png\"",
    "clean-assets:png": "tsx scripts/resize-images.ts",
    "clean-assets:svg": "svgo -rf src -o src",
    "convert-new-assets-to-svg": "tsx scripts/convert-new-assets-to-svg.ts",
    "format": "prettier --cache --log-level warn --write \"**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx,mjs,mts,md,mdx,json}\"",
    "json-to-ts": "tsx scripts/json-to-ts.ts",
    "lint": "concurrently \"pnpm format\" \"pnpm lint:ts\" \"pnpm type-check\"",
    "lint:ts": "eslint --cache --quiet --fix .",
    "schemas-to-typescript": "concurrently \"json2ts schema/vaults-schema.json src/types/vaults.d.ts\" \"json2ts schema/protocols-schema.json src/types/protocols.d.ts\" \"json2ts schema/tokens-schema.json src/types/tokens.d.ts\" \"json2ts schema/validators-schema.json src/types/validators.d.ts\"",
    "schemas-to-typescript-and-format": "pnpm schemas-to-typescript && pnpm format",
    "sort": "concurrently \"tsx scripts/sort-vaults.ts\" \"tsx scripts/sort-protocols.ts\" \"tsx scripts/sort-tokens.ts\" \"tsx scripts/sort-validators.ts\"",
    "sort-and-format": "pnpm sort && pnpm format",
    "publish": "pnpm json-to-ts && pnpm lint && npm publish --access public",
    "sort-package-json": "pnpm dlx sort-package-json",
    "type-check": "tsc --noEmit",
    "validate": "concurrently \"pnpm validate-protocols\" \"pnpm validate-tokens\" \"pnpm validate-validators\" \"pnpm validate-vaults\"",
    "validate-protocols": "tsx scripts/validate-protocols.ts",
    "validate-tokens": "tsx scripts/validate-tokens.ts",
    "validate-validators": "tsx scripts/validate-validators.ts",
    "validate-vaults": "tsx scripts/validate-vaults.ts"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@infrared-dao/eslint-config": "^0.0.6",
    "@infrared-dao/prettier-config": "^0.0.2",
    "@infrared-dao/tsconfig": "^0.0.2",
    "@neplex/vectorizer": "^0.0.5",
    "@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports": "^5.2.2",
    "@types/node": "^22.15.3",
    "@types/slug": "^5.0.9",
    "ajv": "^8.17.1",
    "ajv-formats": "^2.1.1",
    "concurrently": "^9.1.2",
    "glob": "^11.0.2",
    "globals": "^16.0.0",
    "json-schema-to-typescript": "^15.0.4",
    "prettier": "^3.5.3",
    "prettier-plugin-sort-json": "^4.1.1",
    "sharp": "^0.34.1",
    "slug": "^10.0.0",
    "svgo": "^3.3.2",
    "tsx": "^4.19.3",
    "typescript": "^5.8.3",
    "viem": "^2.28.0"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.10.0",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20.5.1",
    "npm": "please-use-pnpm",
    "pnpm": ">=10",
    "yarn": "please-use-pnpm"
  }
}

# Extending vaults, tokens, or validators

This README provides instructions for third parties on how to add their vault, token, or validator to our application.

## Prerequisites

Before you begin, ensure you have:

1. A GitHub account
2. Basic knowledge of JSON and Git
3. Details for your vault, token, or validator

Please make sure that the respective beraRewardsVault is whitelisted. In order to check that please follow the guideline:

1. Go to Berachef’s contract on Berascan(0xdf960E8F3F19C481dDE769edEDD439ea1a63426a) & select “Read Contract“
2. Go to function 16. isWhitelistedVault
3. Under receiver parameter put the beraRewardsVault address
4. Click “Query“
5. If the boolean is “true”, the vault is yielding BGT (desired path)
6. If the boolean is “false”, the vault is not yielding BGT. In this case, please refer to the Berachain team, their governance, and their documentation

## Steps to add

### 1. Fork the repository

### 2. Add your assets

You only need to provide assets if they're not already in the `src/assets` folder or if you're introducing new elements (e.g., a new protocol or token). For any new or missing assets:

Add any new token assets to `/src/assets/tokens` and new protocol assets to `src/assets/protocols`.

- You should use an SVG file.
- If you absolutely do not have an SVG file add a png to `src/assets/tokens/new` or `src/assets/protocols/new`. Ensure it is larger than 128x128 and is very high quality.

### 3. Update JSON files

1. Navigate to `src/vaults/{network}.json` where `{network}` is the network you're adding to (e.g., "mainnet" for the Berachain mainnet).

2. Add your vault to the `vaults` array in the JSON file. Follow this structure:

   ```json
   {
     "beraRewardsVault": "0x...",
     "slug": "protocol-stake-token-name",
     "stakeTokenAddress": "0x..."
   }
   ```

   Ensure that:

   - The `mintUrl` field is a direct link to provide liquidity for the LP token
   - The `name` field only uses the symbols of the underlying tokens with a dash between. Example: `HONEY-WBERA`.
   - `protocol` matches an `id` in the `protocols` array
   - `types` contains valid types from the `types` object
   - All `underlyingTokens` are listed in the tokens (`src/tokens/{network}.json`)

3. If your protocol is not listed in the `protocols` array, add it:

   ```json
   {
     "description": "A brief description of your protocol.",
     "id": "your_unique_protocol_id",
     "imageDark": "your-protocol-image.svg",
     "imageLight": "your-protocol-image.svg",
     "name": "Protocol",
     "url": "https://your-protocol-url.com"
   }
   ```

   Ensure that:

   - The `id` field is lowercase.
   - The `Name` field is a singular word in most cases. `Kodiak` instead of `Kodiak Finance` for example.
   - You've added the protocol image to the `src/assets/protocols` folder if it's not already there.

4. If your vault uses tokens not in the tokens, add them to `src/tokens/{network}.json`:

   ```json
   {
     "address": "0x...",
     "decimals": 18,
     "image": "your-token-image.svg",
     "mintUrl": "https://your-protocol-url.com/provide-liquidity",
     "name": "XYZ",
     "protocol": "your_protocol_id",
     "symbol": "XYZ",
     "type": "amm",
     "underlyingTokens": ["0x...", "0x..."]
   }
   ```

   Ensure that:

   - The `mintUrl` field is a direct link to provide liquidity for the LP token
   - The `name` field only uses the symbols of the underlying tokens with a dash between. Example: `HONEY-WBERA`.
   - `protocol` matches an `id` in the `protocols` array
   - You've added the token image to the `src/assets/tokens` folder if it's not already there.

5. Commit your changes and push to your forked repository.

6. Create a Pull Request (PR) from your fork to this repository.

## Guidelines

- Ensure all addresses are valid and correctly formatted.
- Use clear, descriptive names for your vault, protocol, and tokens.
- Provide accurate and concise descriptions.
- Use appropriate tags and types.
- The `url` field for vaults should be a direct link to provide liquidity for the LP token.
- Make sure you're updating the correct network-specific files (replace `{network}` with the appropriate network name).

## Review process

After submitting your PR:

1. Our team will review your submission.
2. We may request changes or clarifications if needed.
3. Once approved, your changes will be merged and become visible in the app for the specified network.

Thank you for contributing to our ecosystem!

### Internal review process

If a `png`/`webp` image is submitted, ensure a `svg` has been generated. If not, ensure the assets are in the `assets/*/new` folder and run `convert-new-assets-to-svg`. If the svg looks good and is smaller than the webp then use it, otherwise use the webp.
